newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-PAVIN PULLS OUT OF PGA AFTER DEATH OF HIS FATHER.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PAVIN PULLS OUT OF PGA AFTER DEATH OF HIS FATHER.

text.p: Corey Pavin pulled out of the 79th PGA Championship on the eve of the opening round after learning Wednesday that his father had died.
Pavin learned of the death of his father, Jack, from his brother Fletcher, who reached the 1995 U.S. Open champion at Winged Foot golf club by telephone on Wednesday morning.
Jack Pavin, who had a history of heart trouble, died in his sleep at home, aged 70, PGA officials said.
The withdrawal of Pavin from the 150-man field seemed to end his chances at selection onto the Ryder Cup team.
Pavin, a star on recent U.S. teams, has struggled with his game in recent months since making a change in his clubs.
It was believed that only an impressive performance at the PGA would make him a viable candidate for one of U.S. captain Tom Kite's two captain's picks, to be announced on Monday.
Pavin, who stands 43rd on the Ryder Cup points list, was replaced in the PGA field by Taylor Smith.
Australian Peter Senior also withdrew from the tournament on Wednesday. His place was taken by Glen Day.
